records.name: Chondro Jointaide

selectedPackage.scope: Selected package and full copy confirmed. The approval covers the selected formulation and content.

records.visibleFront: NutriDyn Chondro Jointaide, 60 packets. The page exposes one gallery image stem with alternate sizes and no revision-bearing panel.
records.finding: The current official listing agrees with the approved selected formula and package count. The original and gallery PNGs show the front only, with no revision or formula evidence tying these exact image bytes to the selected 9/24 label. The historic ND181 description names a different third component, so a shared name and count are insufficient for the image version join.
records.preciseMissingInput: An official revision-linked R149C 9/24 packshot, a manufacturer media record tying r149c-Base-33816_1.png to rev. 9/24, or an official gallery including a matching revision-bearing panel.

records.name: Fruits & Greens
records.visibleFront: NutriDyn Fruits & Greens Strawberry Kiwi, 30 servings, net wt. 10.67 oz (302.7 g).
records.draftAltText: NutriDyn Fruits & Greens Strawberry Kiwi powder, 30 servings, in a 302.7 g canister.
records.finding: NutriDyn now yields an exact-code flavor front. For a 10.09 g serving the main page lists 38 kcal, 1 g fiber, 162 mg vitamin C and 2.92 g SuperFruitox. The manufacturer's ND1301 sheet and product portal list 35 kcal, under 1 g fiber, 99 mg vitamin C and 2.86 g SuperFruitox. The exact-code front does not distinguish the panels.
records.preciseMissingInput: The Xenios-selected Strawberry Kiwi jar panel and revision, with net weight reconciled to the exact-code front.
